- `pub fn iv_pm(c: f64, h: f64) -> Interval { let a = fabs(h); Interval { lo: c - a, hi: c + a } }` — *data/interval.sio*

- `pub fn iv_hi(a: Interval) -> f64 { a.hi }` — *data/interval.sio*

- `pub fn iv_width(a: Interval) -> f64 { a.hi - a.lo }` — *data/interval.sio*
- `pub fn iv_rad(a: Interval) -> f64 with Div, Panic { 0.5 * (a.hi - a.lo) }` — *data/interval.sio*
- `pub fn iv_add(a: Interval, b: Interval) -> Interval { Interval { lo: a.lo + b.lo, hi: a.hi + b.hi } }` — *data/interval.sio*
